rust_summary: typed-error variants of the inventory helpers (`NativeInventoryError`), beside the text-error ones (`native_move_stack_typed` and kin).
doc_summary: `native_move_stack_typed`, `native_set_inventory_typed`, `native_set_inventory_slot_typed` and `native_take_stacks_typed` make the same checks and changes as their untyped helpers (`native_move_stack`, `native_set_inventory`, `native_set_inventory_slot`, `native_take_stacks`), but Err a `NativeInventoryError` (matchable: `InsidePlayerTurn`, `NotOnline`, `StackChanged`, `NoRoom`, ... `File(text)`) instead of text. Bundles need "hooks": @API:inventory_typed@.
